messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants me to create an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative challenge. Let me think about what elements I need:

1. A pelican - distinctive features: large body, long beak with a pouch, webbed feet, wings
2. A bicycle - two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals, seat
3. The pelican should appear to be riding the bicycle - sitting on the seat, wings/hands gripping handlebars, feet on pedals

Let me design this step by step:

- Bicycle: Two wheels with spokes, a diamond frame, handlebars, seat, pedals
- Pelican: Body sitting on the seat, wings reaching to handlebars, feet near pedals, head above with long beak pointing forward
- Style: I'll use simple but recognizable shapes, maybe some fun colors

Let me sketch this out mentally:
- The bicycle frame will be a diamond/triangle shape
- Wheels at front and back
- Pelican body sitting on the saddle
- Wings as arms reaching forward to handlebars
- Feet at the pedal area
- Head sticking up above the body with the characteristic long beak

I'll use a combination of paths, circles, and ellipses. Let me build this carefully.

Color scheme:
- Pelican: white/light gray body, orange/yellow beak
- Bicycle: dark frame, maybe colorful accents
- Some background or ground

Let me write the SVG with reasonable coordinates. I'll use a viewBox of something like 0 0 500 400.

Bicycle wheels: circles at roughly (150, 300) and (350, 300) with radius 50
Frame connecting them
Seat at around (220, 220)
Handlebars at around (330, 200)
Pedals around (240, 280)

Pelican body: ellipse centered around (230, 220)
Wings: curved paths reaching to handlebars
Head: circle/ellipse at around (250, 170)
Beak: long shape pointing forward/down
Feet: small shapes near pedals

Let me create a nice, complete SVG.

      .spoke { stroke: #555; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background sky -->
  <rect width="500" height="400" fill="#b8e4f0"/>
  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="340" width="500" height="60" fill="#7a9a3e"/>
